turns.playerInput: > You ask the innkeeper who the woman with the coin is.
turns.modelOutput: "Mira Vale," the innkeeper says. "Passing through, same as you."

turns.label: T5 first interaction with the activated NPC
turns.playerInput: > You cross the room and ask Mira Vale if the northern road is still open.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale looks up. The coin stops on her knuckle. "Open," she says, "if you don't mind the drifts. I came down it this morning." She studies you a moment longer than politeness requires.

turns.label: T6 continued interaction
turns.playerInput: > You sit down across from her and tell her your name.
turns.modelOutput: "Azure," Mira Vale repeats, as if filing it somewhere. "Mira." She does not offer a hand, but she does not move away either. "You're going north, then. Alone?"

turns.label: T7 relationship-relevant beat
turns.playerInput: > You admit you are travelling alone and ask if she would consider going together.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale is quiet for a while. "I don't travel with people I don't know," she says, then, after a pause, "but I'd share a road for a day and see." It is not trust. It is the shape trust would take, if it came.

turns.label: T8 quiet turn
turns.playerInput: > You agree, and order two bowls of stew.
turns.modelOutput: The stew arrives steaming. Mira Vale eats without ceremony, watching the door out of habit.

turns.label: C1 valid V (View) record
turns.cco: (CCO|V|P|%E%|Likes|M|Azure asked after her road and shared what she had.)
turns.playerInput: > You offer Mira Vale the warmer seat by the fire.
turns.modelOutput: She takes it after a beat. "Kind," she says, like a word she is testing.

turns.label: C2 valid S (State) record
turns.cco: (CCO|S|S|%E%|curiosity,hope|Mira Vale accepted a seat by the fire from a stranger.|I did not expect to be offered anything without a price.)
turns.playerInput: > You ask her what she is heading north for.
turns.modelOutput: "Work," Mira Vale says. "The honest kind, if it exists up there."

turns.label: C3 valid R (Relationship) record
turns.cco: (CCO|R|P|%E%|Trust|D|Cautious trust|She answered a direct question about her reasons without deflecting.)
turns.playerInput: > You tell her you are not going to ask her anything she does not want to answer.
turns.modelOutput: Mira Vale looks at you properly for the first time. "All right," she says.

turns.label: C4 valid N (Name) record
turns.cco: (CCO|N|S|%E%|Mira|Adopted|General|She gave the short form of her name herself.)
turns.playerInput: > You call her Mira and see how she takes it.
turns.modelOutput: "Mira is fine," she says. The coin keeps moving.

turns.playerInput: > You watch the fire for a while.
turns.modelOutput: The logs settle. Outside, the wind picks up.

turns.label: C7 BOGUS evidence ids

turns.label: C9 valid V again after drains
turns.cco: (CCO|V|P|%E%|Likes|M|She stayed at the table after being pressed and returned to easy talk.)
turns.playerInput: > You apologise and change the subject.
turns.modelOutput: "You are not the first to ask," Mira Vale says. "You are the first to stop."
